from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,tempfile,shutil,signal,selectors,json
root=Path.cwd()
work=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cli-cleanup-",dir=os.environ["TMPDIR"]))
try:
    pack=work/"pack";pack.mkdir()
    subprocess.run(["node","scripts/package-payload/CheckPackagePayload.ts","--pack-destination",str(pack)],check=True)
    consumer=work/"consumer";consumer.mkdir()
    subprocess.run(["npm","init","-y"],cwd=consumer,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,check=True)
    subprocess.run(["npm","install","--ignore-scripts","--no-audit","--no-fund","--fetch-retries=0","--fetch-timeout=15000",str(next(pack.glob("*.tgz")))],cwd=consumer,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,check=True)
    package=consumer/"node_modules/@git-stunts/git-warp"
    baseline=package/"bin/baseline-launcher"
    baseline.write_bytes((root/"test/evidence/984-cli-launcher/baseline-wrapper.txt").read_bytes())
    registry=(package/"dist/bin/cli/commands/registry.js").as_uri()
    marker=work/"cleanup-marker"
    preload=work/"inject-fixture.mjs"
    preload.write_text("import {COMMANDS} from "+json.dumps(registry)+";import {writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';const timer=setInterval(()=>{},1000);COMMANDS.set('cleanup-fixture',async()=>({human:'READY',close:async()=>{writeFileSync(process.env.FIXTURE_MARKER,'closed');clearInterval(timer);throw new Error('cleanup fixture failed');},completion:process.env.FIXTURE_SIGNAL==='yes'?undefined:Promise.resolve()}));")
    env=os.environ.copy();env['NODE_OPTIONS']='--import='+str(preload);env['FIXTURE_MARKER']=str(marker)
    outputs=[]
    for wrapper in [baseline,package/"bin/git-warp"]:
        result=subprocess.run(['node',str(wrapper),'cleanup-fixture'],cwd=consumer,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
        assert result.returncode==3 and result.stdout=='READY\n' and 'cleanup fixture failed' in result.stderr and marker.read_text()=='closed',(result.returncode,result.stdout,result.stderr)
        outputs.append((result.returncode,result.stdout,result.stderr))
        marker.unlink()
    assert outputs[0]==outputs[1],outputs
    print('ACTUAL_CLI_INJECTED_COMMAND_CLEANUP_FAILURE_BASELINE_CANDIDATE_PARITY_PASS',flush=True)
    env['FIXTURE_SIGNAL']='yes'
    for stop in [signal.SIGINT,signal.SIGTERM]:
        process=subprocess.Popen(['node',str(package/'bin/git-warp'),'cleanup-fixture'],cwd=consumer,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
        try:
            ready=selectors.DefaultSelector();ready.register(process.stdout,selectors.EVENT_READ)
            assert ready.select(20),'signal fixture readiness timeout'
            assert process.stdout.readline()=='READY\n'
            ready.close();os.kill(process.pid,stop)
            out,err=process.communicate(timeout=20)
            assert process.returncode==3 and marker.read_text()=='closed' and err=='',(process.returncode,out,err)
            marker.unlink()
            print('ACTUAL_CLI_INJECTED_COMMAND_SIGNAL_CLEANUP_FAILURE',stop.name,'EXIT_3_PASS',flush=True)
        finally:
            if process.poll() is None:
                os.killpg(process.pid,signal.SIGKILL);process.wait(timeout=5)
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(work)
